evidencePolicy.publicEligibility: A claim is discoverable only when the record declares its own Grades 6-11 scope, its source ID maps to exactly one supplied extracted document, its named PDF exactly matches that document when present, its exact page evidence is in range, every cited page is an A/B readable Sinhala page, every required field disposition is verified, and every required public dependency is available.
evidencePolicy.reviewBoundary: Markdown extraction is evidence with limits. C/D, image-only, corrupt-font, visual, ambiguous, and missing-PDF cases remain needs-review until original-PDF/manual review.
evidencePolicy.metadataBoundary: Publisher, year, place, licence, reviewer, review date, and Published state are not accepted as evidence unless a real source or review event establishes them.

issueSchema.entityOrPath: Required human-readable display locator; machine navigation uses evidence[].path and evidence[].locator.
